slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers per truck, despite U6 stating each truck can carry up to 2 containers.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Truck capacity is irrelevant or not binding, so the model can ignore the 2-container-per-truck limit.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about truck capacity and did not explicitly mark it as an assumption; the READY_TO_MODEL summary omits the truck capacity constraint entirely.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only unresolved hidden slot is P2 truck capacity, which does not affect the core cost objective or feasibility under the stated cost structure. The agent resolved the P0/P1 modeling issues before READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent clarified the key transportation-modeling assumptions—demand equality, supply inequality, leftover treatment, integrality, and cost structure—but missed the P2 truck capacity detail from U6. Overall interaction quality is strong, with only a minor operational constraint omitted.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
